ci_failure_groups.notes: Main Required Checks and latest retrieved Required Checks logs on the listed current PR heads contain the same three tests in tests/research_cycle/test_registered_execution.py failing (two EXECUTION_FAILED vs ENGINEERING_EXECUTION_COMPLETE assertions and KeyError 'resumed'); log summaries report 3 failed, 413 passed, 1 skipped. This is confirmed only for these sampled heads, not all failures.

PR #428, stacked on #422, now reports a successful Docker run with 417 passed/1 skipped and 9 isolated root-image batches passed; production image remains opt-in. These facts are separate from Required Checks.

At live main SHA the Required Checks workflow has a fixed list and does not discover Round 6 candidate tests. Proposed PR #425 changes add changed-path selection and subprocess execution, but no hosted run has exercised that new behavior yet.
